rubric.R4_attestation: 3 — every fact in this file carries source + verified date; new 2026-10-28 source notes added for GBP products, GBP fixes, industrial page, page enrichment, quote capture, face-blurred photos
rubric.R5_no_invented_data: 3 — ratings only per-branch Google (Winchester 5.0/1, Martinsburg 4.7/6, never blended), price only $$, license details private, USDOT omitted, CWT rates only as supplied by Henry 2026-10-28
rubric.R6_images_honest: 3 — warehouse photos are Henry-supplied, faces blurred, captions say so; wrapped-furniture style examples labelled Style example with credit
rubric.R7_quote_path: 3 — CTAs Get My Flat Rate Quote / Get a flat rate quote only, Short default / Detailed toggle preserves From, To, What is moving; Worker no longer drops supplied contact/services/notes in Short mode (verified 2026-10-28)
